title: cl-ansi-spec document model
description: The semantic model of the standard, one definition per node kind. Generated from the node declarations (make generate); do not edit.

span.title: span
span.description: Where a node came from in the sources: a file, character offsets (end exclusive), a line from 1 and a column from 0.

file.description: The source file name, without directory.

start.description: Character offset of the first character.

end.description: Character offset after the last character.

line.description: Line of the first character, counted from 1.

column.description: Column of the first character, counted from 0.

text.title: text
text.description: A run of plain text; adjacent text is merged into one object.

kind.description: The node kind.

enum-entry-kind.title: entry-kind
enum-entry-kind.description:
What a dictionary entry defines: the text of its \ftype, in
kebab-case.  A variant spelling of one of these in the sources is fixed
by a patch, not by a value of its own.

oneOf.description:
An ordinary function, called with evaluated arguments
(\ftype{Function}).

A class the implementation may define as a built-in
class rather than a standard class (\ftype{System Class}).
A global macro, expanded before evaluation (\ftype{Macro}).

A type of condition, signalled to the handlers
(\ftype{Condition Type}).

A dynamic variable whose value may change
(\ftype{Variable}).
A type that is not a class (\ftype{Type}).

A function that reads a place and, through setf, writes
it (\ftype{Accessor}).
A generic function of the standard, whose methods users may addn(\ftype{Standard Generic Function}).

An operator with its own evaluation rule, not a
macro or function (\ftype{Special Operator}).

A symbol that is only a compound type specifier,
naming no type alone (\ftype{Type Specifier}).

A variable whose value never changes
(\ftype{Constant Variable}).

The identifier of a declaration, used in declare and
proclaim (\ftype{Declaration}).

The name of a restart the standard establishes or invokes
(\ftype{Restart}).
A macro defined only within another form (\ftype{Local Macro}).
A standard class, defined as by defclass (\ftype{Class}).

A symbol described for its own sake, neither operator,
variable nor type (\ftype{Symbol}).
A function defined only within another form (\ftype{Local Function}).

enum-operator.title: operator
enum-operator.description: The kind of operator a signature describes, by the macro that sets it.

oneOf.description: A special operator: \Defspec and its variants.
A generic function: \Defgen and its variants.
A method of a generic function: \Defmeth.

enum-reference-kind.title: reference-kind
enum-reference-kind.description:
The macro a reference to a defined name was written with, which says
what kind of name it means.

oneOf.description: \clref: a defined name of any kind.
\kwd, \kwdref: a keyword, written with its colon.

\keyref: a lambda list keyword, written with its
ampersand.
\ttref: a name set in the typewriter font.

\misc, \miscref: a symbol of no other kind (t, nil, a
restart).

enum-index-kind.title: index-kind
enum-index-kind.description: What an index entry indexes, by its macro.

oneOf.description: \idxkeyref: a lambda list keyword, without its ampersand.

enum-part-of-speech.title: part-of-speech
enum-part-of-speech.description: The part of speech of a glossary term, by its macro.

enum-usage.title: usage
enum-usage.description: Where a glossary sense comes from or is used, by its macro.

oneOf.description: \ANSI: a sense the standard itself fixes.
\IEEE: the sense of the IEEE standards.
\ISO: the sense of the ISO standards.

\Traditional: a traditional sense, kept for
compatibility with earlier usage.
\Computers: the sense of computing in general.

enum-math-class.title: math-class
enum-math-class.description: The class of a noad, as TeX gives it.

oneOf.description: A large operator (a sum, an integral).
A box centred on the axis (\vcenter).
A radical (\radical), its sign the noad's delimiter.
An accented nucleus (\mathaccent), its accent the noad's.

enum-math-style.title: math-style
enum-math-style.description: A style of math, as TeX names it.

target-chapter.title: chapter
target-chapter.description:
A chapter, by its id: the target of a \secref whose label a
\DefineChapter defines.

kind.description: The target kind: which sort of node the id names.

id.description: The id of the node pointed to, unique among its target kind.

target-section.title: section
target-section.description:
A section of any level, by its id: the target of a \secref whose
label a \DefineSection defines.

kind.description: The target kind: which sort of node the id names.

id.description: The id of the node pointed to, unique among its target kind.

target-entry.title: entry
target-entry.description:
A dictionary entry, by its id: the target of \clref and its
wrappers (\funref, \macref, …).

kind.description: The target kind: which sort of node the id names.

id.description: The id of the node pointed to, unique among its target kind.

target-figure.title: figure
target-figure.description: A figure, by its id: the target of \figref and \thenextfigure.

kind.description: The target kind: which sort of node the id names.

id.description: The id of the node pointed to, unique among its target kind.

target-glossary.title: glossary
target-glossary.description: A glossary entry, by its id: the target of \term and \newterm.

kind.description: The target kind: which sort of node the id names.

id.description: The id of the node pointed to, unique among its target kind.

document.title: document
document.description:
The whole standard: the root of the model, built from every chapter
job.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

version.title: version
version.description: The revision of the draft, the text of \rev in setup-version.tex.

front-matter.title: front-matter
front-matter.description:
The unnumbered chapters of chap-0.tex (\beginSimpleChapter), in
order; absent when the model is built from part of the jobs.

chapters.title: chapters
chapters.description:
The numbered chapters (\beginchapter), 1 to 26, then the
appendix A, in that order.

chapter.title: chapter
chapter.description:
A chapter: a numbered one begun by \beginchapter, or an unnumbered
one of the front matter begun by \beginSimpleChapter or
\beginSimpleChapterLeft.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

id.title: id
id.description:
The chapter's id: the reference name of \beginchapter (its third
argument, e.g. ChapOne), or a simple chapter's title.

number.title: number
number.description:
The chapter's number as \beginchapter's first argument gives it
("1" … "26", "A"); absent for a simple chapter.

title.title: title
title.description:
The chapter's title, \beginchapter's second argument or the
simple chapter's one.

children.title: children
children.description:
What the chapter holds, in order: the blocks before its first
section, then its sections.

section.title: section
section.description:
A section of any level: \beginSection or \includeDictionary (level
1), \beginSubsection (2), \beginsubsubsection (3),
\beginsubsubsubsection (4) or \beginsubsubsubsubsection (5).  It runs
to the next section of its level or above, or the chapter's end.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

id.title: id
id.description:
The label of the \DefineSection that names the section, or
<parent-id>/<n> for a section that none names (its n-th among its
parent's sections).

number.title: number
number.description:
The section's number, its chapter's and the count of each level
joined by dots ("14.1.2"), as the :write of its \DefineSection
confirms.

level.title: level
level.description:
The level, 1 for a section of the chapter, 2 for a subsection,
and so on to 5.

dictionary.title: dictionary
dictionary.description:
True for a dictionary section, begun by \includeDictionary: its
children are dictionary entries.

title.title: title
title.description: The section's title, the argument of the macro that began it.

children.title: children
children.description:
What the section holds, in order: blocks, dictionary entries,
glossary groups and its subsections.

dictionary-entry.title: dictionary-entry
dictionary-entry.description:
A dictionary entry, from \begincom to \endcom: the description of
one or more defined names of one kind.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

id.title: id
id.description:
The entry's id: its first name, or <name>/<entry-kind> when two
entries share a first name (docs/exports.md, "Ids").

names.title: names
names.description:
The names the entry describes, the comma-separated list of
\begincom's first argument, in order.

entry-kind.title: entry-kind
entry-kind.description: What the names are, from the entry's \ftype.

parts.title: parts
parts.description: The entry's parts, one per \label, in order.

part.title: part
part.description:
A part of a dictionary entry: a \label heading (Syntax, Arguments and
Values, Description, …) and what follows it up to the next \label or
the entry's end.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

title.title: title
title.description: The heading, the text of the \label before its colon.

none.title: none
none.description:
True when the part says only "None." (\None after the
\label).

confidence.title: confidence
confidence.description:
For a part that says None: the punctuation after it in the
source (".", "!" or "?"), how sure the authors are that the part
is empty; absent otherwise.

content.title: content
content.description: The part's blocks; absent when NONE is true.

operator-signature.title: operator-signature
operator-signature.description:
The syntax of an operator as a Syntax part sets it: \Defun,
\Defmac, \Defspec, \Defgen and their WithValues, WithValuesNewline
and NoReturn variants, \Defmeth, \DefunMultiWithValues, and the
reader half of \DefunMultiAccessorWithValues.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

operator.title: operator
operator.description: The kind of operator, by the macro.

names.title: names
names.description:
The operator's name, or the names of the \entry lines of a
-Multi form, which share the lambda list and values.

lambda-list.title: lambda-list
lambda-list.description:
The lambda list as written, with its parameters and lambda list
keywords; absent when empty.

values.title: values
values.description:
The values as written after the arrow; absent for a form
without values (\Defun, \Defmeth) and when NO-RETURN is true.

no-return.title: no-return
no-return.description: True for a NoReturn form: the operator never returns normally.

setf-signature.title: setf-signature
setf-signature.description:
The syntax of a setf form: \Defsetf, \DefsetfMulti, and the setf
half of \DefunMultiAccessorWithValues.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

names.title: names
names.description:
The accessor's name, or the names of the \entry lines of a
-Multi form.

lambda-list.title: lambda-list
lambda-list.description: The accessor's lambda list as written; absent when empty.

variable-signature.title: variable-signature
variable-signature.description:
The syntax of a variable or a constant: \Defvar, \Defvarnoast,
\Defcon.  No entry of the sources uses them (a variable's entry has
no signature), so no node of the spec is an example of the builder's
output.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

name.title: name
name.description:
The variable's name, with its asterisks when the source sets
them.

type-signature.title: type-signature
type-signature.description: The syntax of a compound type specifier: \Deftype.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

syntax.title: syntax
syntax.description:
The lines of the compound form after the name, with their BNF
notation; absent when there are none.

paragraph.title: paragraph
paragraph.description:
A paragraph: the text TeX set from the start of horizontal mode to
\par.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

content.title: content
content.description: The paragraph's text and inlines, in order.

examples.text: is that part of an environment ...

code-block.title: code-block
code-block.description: Code, from \code to \endcode, each line as it is written.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

lines.title: lines
lines.description: The lines, in order, blank ones included.

code-line.title: code-line
code-line.description: A line of a code block.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

content.title: content
content.description:
The line's text, its spaces kept, and its inlines (terms,
example notation); absent for a blank line.

item-list.title: item-list
item-list.description:
A list, from \beginlist to \endlist, or the items of a level below
\item (\itemitem, \itemitemitem) that follow one another.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

item.title: item
item.description:
An item of a list: \item, \itemitem or \itemitemitem and what
follows it up to the next item of its level or above, or the list's
end.  Items of a lower level after it form an item list in its content.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

label.title: label
label.description:
The item's label, the macro's argument (a bullet, a number, a
term); absent when empty.

editor-note.title: editor-note
editor-note.description:
An editor's note, \editornote: a remark of the editors, not part of
the standard, kept whatever the options say.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

examples.text: KMP: ``derivatives??'' terminology to be worked on.

hidden.title: hidden
hidden.description:
True when the options (\editornotesfalse) hide the note from
the typeset document.

content.text: KMP: ``derivatives??'' terminology to be worked on.

reviewer-note.title: reviewer-note
reviewer-note.description:
A reviewer's note, \reviewer: a remark of a reviewer, not part of
the standard, kept whatever the options say.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

examples.text: Is the order of other things specified??

hidden.title: hidden
hidden.description:
True when the options (\editornotesfalse) hide the note from
the typeset document.

content.text: Is the order of other things specified??

table.title: table
table.description:
A table: an alignment (\halign, as \tabletwo, \tablefigtwo …,
\displaytwo … and \showtwo … set it) read as rows of cells.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.
The node kind; picks this definition out.

header.title: header
header.description:
True for a row of column headings (the heading arguments of
\tablefigtwo and its relatives).

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

content.title: content
content.description: The cell's text and inlines; absent for an empty cell.

columns.title: columns
columns.description:
The number of columns the cell spans when \span joined more
than one; absent for one.

figure.title: figure
figure.description:
A figure: a numbered display with a caption (\endfig, \tablefigtwo
and its relatives).

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

id.title: id
id.description:
The label of the \DefineFigure that names the figure, or
<chapter-id>/fig-<n> for a figure that none names.

number.title: number
number.description:
The figure's number, its chapter's and its own joined by a
hyphen ("14-1"), from the caption, checked against the :write of its
\DefineFigure when there is one.

caption.title: caption
caption.description:
The caption's text after the number; absent when the figure has
none.

content.title: content
content.description: What the figure shows: a table, or other blocks.

term-ref.title: term-ref
term-ref.description:
A use of a glossary term: \term, or \newterm and \newtermidx where
the text defines the term.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

text.title: text
text.description: The term as written, inflected ("dotted lists").

defining.title: defining
defining.description: True for \newterm and \newtermidx: the use defines the term.

sense.title: sense
sense.description:
The glossary sense meant, from the \meaning that follows;
absent when none does.

target.title: target
target.description: The glossary entry of the term; absent while unresolved.

operator-ref.title: operator-ref
operator-ref.description: A reference to a defined name: \clref and its wrappers.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

text.title: text
text.description: The name as the reference sets it.

via.title: via
via.description: The macro the reference was written with.

target.title: target
target.description: The dictionary entry of the name; absent while unresolved.

section-ref.title: section-ref
section-ref.description: A reference to a section or a chapter: \secref.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

label.title: label
label.description: The label referred to, as written after \secref.

target.title: target
target.description: The section or chapter of the label; absent while unresolved.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

label.title: label
label.description: The label referred to, as written after \figref.

target.title: target
target.description: The figure of the label; absent while unresolved.

this-section.title: this-section
this-section.description:
The words `this section': \thissection, \Thissection, a reference to
the section they are in.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

target.title: target
target.description: The section the words are in; absent while unresolved.

next-figure.title: next-figure
next-figure.description:
The words `Figure N-M' for the figure that follows: \thenextfigure,
\Thenextfigure.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

target.title: target
target.description: The next figure; absent while unresolved.

param.title: param
param.description: A parameter of the operator described: \param.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

metavariable.title: metavariable
metavariable.description: A metavariable, in double angle brackets: \metavar, \metaparam.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.
The node kind; picks this definition out.

name.title: name
name.description: The directive after its tilde, e.g. "A".

lambda-list-keyword.title: lambda-list-keyword
lambda-list-keyword.description:
A lambda list keyword in a lambda list: \opt, \rest, \key and their
relatives.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

name.title: name
name.description: The keyword with its ampersand, e.g. "&optional".

code.title: code
code.description:
Code within text: \f, \ff, and text in the typewriter font outside
vocabulary entries.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

emphasis.title: emphasis
emphasis.description: Emphasis: \i, \j, and italic text outside vocabulary entries.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

strong.title: strong
strong.description: Strong emphasis: \b, and bold text outside vocabulary entries.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

evaluates-to.title: evaluates-to
evaluates-to.description: The arrow `evaluates to' of an example: \EV.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

may-evaluate-to.title: may-evaluate-to
may-evaluate-to.description:
The arrow `might evaluate to' (implementation-dependent) of an
example: \OV.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

does-not-evaluate-to.title: does-not-evaluate-to
does-not-evaluate-to.description: The arrow `does not evaluate to' of an example: \NV.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

equivalent.title: equivalent
equivalent.description: The sign `is equivalent to' of an example: \EQ.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

output.title: output
output.description:
The triangle that marks the output of an example, which follows it:
\OUT.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.
The node kind; picks this definition out.

citation.title: citation
citation.description:
The title of a work the standard cites: \CLtL, \CLtLTwo and the
other citation macros of setup-terms.tex.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

index-entry.title: index-entry
index-entry.description:
An entry of the index: an anchor where the text indexes a name or a
phrase, \idxref and its relatives.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

issue-start.title: issue-start
issue-start.description:
Where the text an X3J13 issue brought begins: \issue.  Issues are
ranges that may cross blocks and sections, so they are anchors.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

issue-end.title: issue-end
issue-end.description:
Where the text an X3J13 issue brought ends: \endissue, the one end
of the issue-start before it with its name.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

glossary-group.title: glossary-group
glossary-group.description:
The glossary entries under one letter heading, from \firstindextab
or \indextab to the next.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

letter.title: letter
letter.description:
The heading's letter, or the heading for the entries that do not
begin with a letter.

glossary-entry.title: glossary-entry
glossary-entry.description:
A glossary entry, from \gentry to the next \gentry, \indextab or
the glossary's end.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

pronunciation.title: pronunciation
pronunciation.description:
How the term is pronounced, \pronounced's argument, with its
stress marks; absent when not given.

parts-of-speech.title: parts-of-speech
parts-of-speech.description:
The parts of speech given after the term, before the senses, in
order.

usages.title: usages
usages.description:
The usages given after the term, before the senses, that hold
for every sense.

senses.title: senses
senses.description:
The senses, in order; one, without a number, when the entry is
not numbered.

glossary-sense.title: glossary-sense
glossary-sense.description:
A sense of a glossary term: a numbered definition (`1.', `2.', …), or
the entry's one definition.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

number.title: number
number.description: The sense's number; absent when the entry has one sense.

parts-of-speech.title: parts-of-speech
parts-of-speech.description: The parts of speech given for this sense alone.

usages.title: usages
usages.description: The usages given for this sense alone.

content.title: content
content.description:
The definition's text, its \term references and its `See'
pointers.

glossary-example.title: glossary-example
glossary-example.description: An example of a glossary sense, set in quotes: \gexample.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-rule.title: bnf-rule
bnf-rule.description: A BNF rule: \auxbnf, a non-terminal and its definition.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

definition.title: definition
definition.description:
The right side, with its notation and line breaks; the name and
the glyphs the notation macros typeset (brackets, parentheses, stars) are
not repeated in it.

bnf-break.title: bnf-break
bnf-break.description: A line break within the right side of a BNF rule: \CR.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-optional.title: bnf-optional
bnf-optional.description:
What may appear once or not at all, in brackets: \brac, or \lbrac
… \rbrac split over lines.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-zero-or-more.title: bnf-zero-or-more
bnf-zero-or-more.description: What may appear any number of times, starred: \star.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-one-or-more.title: bnf-one-or-more
bnf-one-or-more.description: What appears one or more times, with a plus: \plus.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-repeat-previous.title: bnf-repeat-previous
bnf-repeat-previous.description:
A plus alone: what precedes appears one or more times (\prevplus,
after a group split over lines).

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-group.title: bnf-group
bnf-group.description:
A group, usually of alternatives, in braces: \curly, or \lcurly …
\rcurly split over lines.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-parenthesized.title: bnf-parenthesized
bnf-parenthesized.description: Its content in literal parentheses: \paren, or \lparen … \rparen.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-bracketed.title: bnf-bracketed
bnf-bracketed.description:
Its content in literal brackets, in the code font: \ttbrac, or
\lttbrac … \rttbrac.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-interleave.title: bnf-interleave
bnf-interleave.description:
Alternatives in any order, each at most once: \interleave, or
\begininterleave … \endinterleave.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-required.title: bnf-required
bnf-required.description: Within an interleaving, what must appear exactly once: \one.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-indirection.title: bnf-indirection
bnf-indirection.description: A non-terminal whose definition is spliced in place: \down.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

bnf-caret.title: bnf-caret
bnf-caret.description: The caret character `^' of a syntax description: \hat.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

angle-name.title: angle-name
angle-name.description:
A name in angle brackets: \ang, the names of characters
(\NewlineChar) and \noargs.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

math.title: math
math.description: A formula: inline between $ and $, or displayed between $$ and $$.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

equation-number.title: equation-number
equation-number.description:
A display's equation number, \eqno or \leqno; absent when it
has none.

math-noad.title: math-noad
math-noad.description: A noad: a nucleus of some class with its scripts.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

limits.title: limits
limits.description:
True for an operator whose scripts go above and below
(\limits).

delimiter.title: delimiter
delimiter.description:
A radical's sign or an accent's character, as Unicode; absent
for other classes.

nucleus.title: nucleus
nucleus.description: The nucleus: one character, or a subformula; absent for {}.

math-char.title: math-char
math-char.description: A character of a formula, mapped from its family's font to Unicode.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

math-fraction.title: math-fraction
math-fraction.description: A fraction: \over, \atop, \above and their withdelims forms.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

no-rule.title: no-rule
no-rule.description:
True when no bar separates the two (\atop, or a zero
thickness).

left-delimiter.title: left-delimiter
left-delimiter.description:
The delimiter on the left of a withdelims form, as Unicode;
absent otherwise.

right-delimiter.title: right-delimiter
right-delimiter.description:
The delimiter on the right of a withdelims form, as Unicode;
absent otherwise.

math-delimiter.title: math-delimiter
math-delimiter.description: A delimiter that grows with its subformula: \left or \right.

kind.description: The node kind; picks this definition out.

text.title: text
text.description: The delimiter, as Unicode; absent for the null delimiter (.).

math-style-change.title: math-style-change
math-style-change.description:
